# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_STAGE2_GRINDER_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The sniper stage2 grinder top keeper improves the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK setup by tightening exit parameters (premium stop, TP1, profit lock) and adjusting trigger sensitivity (volume multiplier, body minimum, star requirement). The hypothesis is that these changes increase win rate and reduce losses on non-J days while maintaining or improving capture on J winner days, though current edge_capture on J anchors is subthreshold.

## Mechanism

**Entry triggers:** Requires volume >= vol_mult (1.1) x 20-bar average, candle body >= body_min_cents (0.02), min_stars (2), strike_offset (2) OTM-2, proximity_dollars (1.5) to level, and require_break_above_open (true) for confirmation.  
**Exit logic:** Premium stop at -6% (catastrophe cap), TP1 at +40% premium (sell 2/3 position), runner target at +3.0x premium, profit lock arms immediately (threshold 0%) and trails at 8% offset from high-water mark. Time stop 15:50 ET.
